No borders, gutters as lines, labels, text, icons, characters, weapons, monsters, buildings, ground tiles, scenery, UI, checkerboard, or colored backdrop. Entire background is exactly PURE BLACK RGB 0,0,0 because each isolated effect will use ADD blending. Keep at least 8% truly black margin inside each cell. No effect touches or leaks over a cell boundary. Every effect is centered and registered consistently from frame to frame; the effect's contact/origin stays fixed as its size changes.

COLUMNS from left to right: 1 anticipation/onset (small restrained energy), 2 strongest clear peak, 3 outward separated fragments, 4 faint dying embers/fragments with mostly black area. Temporal animation keyframes of the SAME effect per row, not different variations. Last column substantially dimmer and sparser than column 2.

ROW4: blue-white magical missile facing SCREEN RIGHT: a compact bright pointed bolt/core with 2-3 fine cyan blue curved trailing strands to the left and a few tiny separated particles. Long readable directional silhouette, not a blue sphere or starburst. Core/contact fixed at cell center.

ROW6: orange downward meteor strike. A short diagonal fiery streak arrives from upper right to a fixed contact at center x,70% cell height; peak golden-orange contact flare and sparse angular stone fragments, then outward embers and thin ground shock ring. Ground ring ellipse height/width0.577, upright plume separate. No stone ground tile, no giant opaque smoke cloud.

calls.prompt:
Create a STRONG ICE-BURST CROWN animation strip for the supplied game, combining the powerful angular cyan crystals of reference image1 with a carefully sized center opening. No labels, numbers, text, icons, panel borders, gutters, checkerboard, gray matte, scenery, smoke or opaque background plate. Black is completely nonemissive for ADD blending. Every effect fits inside its panel with safe black margins. Ground contact centered consistently near(50%,60%) of each panel, unchanged across all four temporal phases.

CRITICAL PEAK DESIGN (panel2):
This must read immediately as an energetic ICE ERUPTION, NOT a magic shield, ward or decorative thin circle. Around the outer annulus place EIGHTEEN TO TWENTY-FOUR clearly visible, substantial, angular ice crystals. Each has faceted translucent cyan/ice-blue faces, a few sharp icy-white edge highlights and dark transparent gaps.
Make8–10 medium/tall shards clustered along the LEFT outer arc and8–10 along the RIGHT outer arc, plus a few modest back-left/back-right shards and small foreground shards. The tallest rear/side crystals rise25–35% of the visible ground ring's WIDTH above their individual ground bases. For a360px-wide ring, major shards are90–125px high, not tiny10px chips. They must be recognizably sharp multi-faceted crystals, not sparks or thin white lines. Create an irregular low-to-medium crown: outer shards lean outward, shorter neighbors fill the groups, several large blades command the silhouette. Bright ice facets and short outward shatter streaks make the peak feel forceful. Controlled glows live along these shards and outer ground contacts.

CENTER OPENING: reserve a clear standing-caster opening ONLY35–40% of the visible ring's WIDTH, centered on the origin. Do NOT make the opening80%of the ring. Crystals must approach the left and right boundaries of that35–40%gap so the whole outer crown feels dense and powerful. There must be NO central crystal pillar or tall shard inside the exact central35%width above the ground-contact line. Keep that standing-body column black and readable. It is a natural hollow center between outer crystals, not a person-shaped mask. Rear clusters can rise behind the caster's head at the back-left and back-right but must leave the exact rear center open. Foreground shards may span the front arc below the origin and rise only10–15%of ring width, so they do not cross the caster's chest or face. Ground light inside the opening remains very faint; no bright central core or vertical beam.

GROUND CAMERA: TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC ISOMETRIC2.5D,45-degree azimuth,35.264-degree elevation,120-degree ground axes. The ring is a DEEP oval with height/width EXACTLY0.57735. A360px-wide ring is208pxhigh, not80pxhigh. Its major axis is horizontal. Show the lower semicircle well below the contact and the upper semicircle behind the crystal crown. No perspective or very flat eye-level ellipse. The ring is a fine secondary frost shockwave beneath strong crystals, not the main feature; avoid ornate ward runes. Sparse broken frost arcs and a few radial ice cracks are enough.

TEMPORAL PANELS from LEFT to RIGHT:
1 ONSET:6–8 shorter outer shards growing, a few restrained partial frost arcs;20–30%of peak total luminous energy.
2 PEAK: the full18–24substantial crystal eruption described above, the brightest and strongest frame.
3 SHATTER: large crystal pieces split outward with clear directional separation and a few short blue-white trails; still leaves caster column clear; roughly50%of peak energy.
4 TAIL: only3–5tiny faint fragments/motes and one or two faint broken arc remnants. Under20%of peak total energy. NO complete bright ring, NO large standing crystals, NO full circle. Most of this panel must be pure black.
All4panels preserve the same origin and coherent ice material. Contemporary fine game-effect art, crisp readable shapes, no cartoon outlines, no huge white bloom blob, no opaque cloud. Favor a powerful crystal silhouette with an unobscured caster over decorative circle markings.
